# Tokpet StopWatch UI component: LVGL v9 integration + round-screen build
# esp_lvgl_port is declared in idf_component.yml; the component manager adds it to REQUIRES automatically.
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "ui.c"
         "assets/claude_logo.c"
         "assets/codex_logo.c"
         "assets/deepseek_logo.c"
         "assets/cat_chill.c" "assets/cat_uneasy.c" "assets/cat_panic.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    REQUIRES esp_lcd esp_lcd_touch lcd_co5300 tokpet_state
)

# Assets generated by LVGLImage.py use `#if defined(LV_LVGL_H_INCLUDE_SIMPLE) #include "lvgl.h"`
# to pick the include branch; this project only defines LV_CONF_INCLUDE_SIMPLE globally, so this macro must be added in this component,
# otherwise the assets fall back to `#include "lvgl/lvgl.h"` (not on the include path) and fail to compile.
target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE LV_LVGL_H_INCLUDE_SIMPLE)
